scientific_integrity: A complete direct bijection proves the all-cardinality enumerator and cut-vertex coefficient. A parsimonious reduction imports a published hardness result. An independent exact checker tested 183 finite base graphs; finite tests are corroborative, not an infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs with exactly one leaf attached per original vertex; the #P-completeness statement relies on the published fixed-target graph-homomorphism theorem; earlier work already counts minimum super dominating sets of these coronas. Full text of Kaidash (2024) was not available for a decisive overlap comparison, so a priority risk remains.
title: Super domination polynomials of leaf coronas as Widom–Rowlinson partition functions
